# opnsense_interfaces_bridge (Data Source)

Bridges connect two or more network interfaces into a single layer 2 segment.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the resource.

### Read-Only

- `address_timeout` (Number) Timeout (in seconds) of bridge address cache entries.
- `auto_edge_ports` (Set of String) Interfaces automatically detecting edge status.
- `auto_ptp_ports` (Set of String) Interfaces automatically detecting point-to-point status.
- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `device` (String) Bridge device name, e.g. `bridge0`.
- `edge_ports` (Set of String) Interfaces set as edge ports.
- `enable_stp` (Boolean) Whether spanning tree options are enabled for this bridge.
- `forward_delay` (Number) Time (in seconds) that must pass before an interface begins forwarding packets when spanning tree is enabled.
- `hold_count` (Number) Number of packets transmitted before being rate limited when spanning tree is enabled.
- `link_local` (Boolean) Whether link-local (IPv6) addresses are enabled on the bridge and its members.
- `max_addresses` (Number) Maximum size of the bridge address cache.
- `max_age` (Number) Time (in seconds) that a spanning tree configuration is valid.
- `members` (Set of String) Assigned interfaces that are members of the bridge.
- `private_ports` (Set of String) Interfaces marked as private.
- `ptp_ports` (Set of String) Interfaces set as point-to-point links.
- `span_interface` (String) Interface a copy of every frame received by the bridge is transmitted on.
- `static_ports` (Set of String) Interfaces marked as static.
- `stp_interfaces` (Set of String) Interfaces spanning tree is enabled on.
- `stp_proto` (String) Spanning tree protocol in use.
